subject: Programming and DS: Data Structures
questionTextRaw: A meld operation on two instances of a data structure combines them into one single instance of the same data structure. Consider the following data structures: P. Unsorted doubly linked list with pointers to the head node and tail node of the list. Q. Min-heap implemented using an array. R. Binary Search Tree. Which ONE of the following options gives the worst-case time complexities for meld operation on instances of size of these data structures? A. B. : C. : D. :
